blurb: Guests participate in themed escape room games lasting 60 minutes, solving puzzles in immersive environments. Rooms accommodate 2 to 12 players, suitable for ages 8 and up with adult supervision recommended for younger children. The facility offers private group bookings, corporate events, birthday parties, and school field trips with educational post-game sessions.
extraNote: Cancel or reschedule with at least 24 hours' notice; no fees for no-shows · No online payment required; pay in person upon arrival · Exit doors are never locked; players may leave anytime without penalty · No food, drinks, or cell phones allowed inside escape rooms; secure storage provided · Photography and video recording prohibited inside escape rooms · Late arrivals may have reduced game time to avoid delays · Located on the left side of T&T Supermarket, main entrance on the corner facing the street.
